name: AirDoctor 3000
description: The AirDoctor AD3000 is a professional-grade air purifier that removes ultra-fine particles from the air. It features a powerful 3-stage filtration system including a pre-filter, an Activated Carbon Filter for odors and VOCs, and the proprietary UltraHEPA® filter. Ideal for medium-to-large rooms, bedrooms, and offices.

specs.features: Air Quality Monitor, Auto Mode, Built-in Ionizer, Night Mode, Clean Filter Indicator, Control Lock

faqs.question: How often should I change the filters?
faqs.answer: The UltraHEPA® filter should be replaced every 12 months, and the Carbon filter every 6 months. The pre-filter should be vacuumed monthly for best performance.

faqs.question: How do I reset the Replace Filter light?
faqs.answer: After changing the filter, press the 'Auto' and 'Dim' buttons together for 3 seconds. The light will flash 3 times and turn off.

faqs.question: What do the air quality colors mean?
faqs.answer: Blue indicates good air quality, Orange indicates fair air quality, and Red indicates poor air quality. In Auto mode, the fan speed adjusts automatically based on these levels.

faqs.question: Does it remove pet odors?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Activated Carbon Filter is specifically designed to remove odors from pets, smoke, and Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs).

faqs.question: How much electricity does it use?
faqs.answer: It is highly energy-efficient, consuming only 11 watts on low and 110 watts on the high setting. It costs approximately $30-40 per year to run 24/7 on Auto-mode.

name: AirDoctor 5000
description: The AirDoctor AD5000 is a powerful professional air purifier designed for extra-large spaces and high ceilings. It features a dual-sided filtration system with two sets of filters to provide maximum airflow and purification speed. Perfect for large living areas and open-concept homes.

specs.features: Dual-sided filtration, Air Quality Monitor, Auto Mode, Built-in Ionizer, Night Mode, Clean Filter Indicator, Control Lock

faqs.question: How many filters does it have?
faqs.answer: The AD5000 has two sets of filters, one on each side of the unit. Each set includes an UltraHEPA filter, an Activated Carbon Filter, and a Pre-Filter. All filters should be replaced at the same time.

faqs.question: How do I reset the filter light?
faqs.answer: To reset the Replace Filter alert, press the 'Auto' and 'Dim' buttons together for 3 seconds. The light will flash 3 times and turn off.

faqs.question: Can I wash the filters?
faqs.answer: No, never wash the UltraHEPA or Carbon filters. The Pre-Filter is reusable but should be vacuumed monthly rather than washed to avoid introducing moisture.

faqs.question: What is the electricity cost?
faqs.answer: The AD5000 is highly energy-efficient, consuming 11-110 watts. It costs approximately $30-40 per year to run 24/7 in Auto-mode.

name: AirDoctor 2000
description: Compact and portable, the AirDoctor 2000 is designed for smaller spaces like nurseries, guest bedrooms, and home offices. Despite its size, it uses the same UltraHEPA technology as the larger models.

faqs.question: Is it quiet enough for a baby's nursery?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. It operates as low as 25 dB, which is quieter than a whisper, making it perfect for sleep environments.

name: AirDoctor 1000
description: The AirDoctor AD1000 is a professional-grade portable tower air purifier designed for desktop use or small bedrooms. It features a powerful purification process including UltraHEPA™ filtration for microscopic particles and a high-quality Carbon filter for odors and VOCs.

specs.features: Air Quality Monitor, Auto Mode, Built-in Ionizer, Night Mode, Clean Filter Indicator, Control Lock

faqs.question: What do the Air Quality Monitor colors mean?
faqs.answer: The LED ring display changes color based on air quality: Blue indicates Good, Orange indicates Fair, and Red indicates Poor air quality.

faqs.question: How do I reset the Clean Filter Indicator light?
faqs.answer: To reset the filter indicator after replacement, press and hold the ION and DIM buttons together for 3 seconds. The light will flash 3 times and turn off.

faqs.question: How often should I clean the filters and sensor?
faqs.answer: Vacuum the outside of the UltraHEPA (pre-filter) every 2 months. Filters generally last at least 6 months. If the air quality monitor stays on one color, clean the sensor chamber at the rear using a vacuum.

faqs.question: Does it have a child lock feature?
faqs.answer: Yes, press the 'Timer' and 'Ion' buttons simultaneously for 3 seconds to activate or deactivate the Control Lock feature.

faqs.question: Does it have an auto mode?
faqs.answer: Yes, in Auto mode, the fan speed automatically adjusts based on air quality: Low for Good, Medium for Fair, and High/Boost for Poor quality.

faqs.question: Where is the best place to position the AirDoctor 1000?
faqs.answer: Place the unit close to the source of air pollution. Ensure it is at least 1 foot away from walls on all sides, and do not place it directly in the path of air from fans or air conditioners.

faqs.question: What should I do if the airflow is reduced or filtering seems poor?
faqs.answer: First, check if you removed the plastic bags from the filters before installation. Also, ensure the inlet or outlet grills aren't blocked and check if the filters need replacement.

faqs.question: What is the warranty for the AirDoctor 1000?
faqs.answer: The air purifier comes with a one-year limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. The UltraHEPA and Carbon filters have a separate 30-day limited warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: Can I use the AirDoctor 1000 in a bathroom or kitchen?
faqs.answer: It is not recommended for use in bathrooms or other wet/humid environments. It should also not be used in greasy environments like kitchens, as it is not designed to filter oil or grease.

faqs.question: Does Auto Mode activate the Ionizer?
faqs.answer: No, Auto Mode only adjusts the fan speed based on air quality. The Ion generator must be turned on or off separately using the ION button.

name: AquaTru Classic
description: The original countertop reverse osmosis water purifier. It transforms tap water into pure, delicious water without the need for plumbing or installation. Uses a 4-stage Ultra Reverse Osmosis process.

specs.stages: 4-stage filtration (Sediment, Pre-Carbon, RO Membrane, VOC Carbon)
specs.tank_capacity: 3 liters (tap water tank) / 2.7 liters (pure water tank)

faqs.question: Does it remove fluoride?
faqs.answer: Yes, AquaTru's reverse osmosis technology is certified to remove up to 95% of fluoride, along with lead, chromium-6, and 80+ other contaminants.

faqs.question: How do I know when to change filters?
faqs.answer: The front panel has filter life indicator lights (1, 2, 3, and 4) that will blink when a specific filter needs replacement.

name: AquaTru Connect
description: The smart version of the Classic countertop purifier. Includes WiFi connectivity and integration with the AquaTru app to monitor water quality, filter life, and savings from not buying bottled water.

specs.smart_features: WiFi, App monitoring, filter alerts, water consumption tracking

faqs.question: What is the difference from Classic?
faqs.answer: The Connect model has the same filtration performance as the Classic but adds WiFi connectivity and a mobile app for tracking filter life and water usage.

faqs.question: Can I use it without the app?
faqs.answer: Yes, it works perfectly as a standalone purifier even if you choose not to use the smart features.

name: AquaTru Under Sink
description: A high-performance reverse osmosis system that installs under your kitchen sink, saving valuable counter space. It provides pure water through a dedicated lead-free faucet.

specs.installation: Professional installation recommended; requires drilling for the faucet

faqs.question: Does it need a dedicated faucet?
faqs.answer: Yes, the system comes with a dedicated lead-free faucet that must be installed on your sink or countertop.

name: AquaTru Carafe
description: A compact countertop RO system that dispenses water into a glass carafe. Perfect for smaller kitchens, singles, or couples. The carafe is fridge-friendly.

specs.footprint: Smallest footprint of all AquaTru models

faqs.question: Can the carafe go in the fridge?
faqs.answer: Yes, the carafe is designed to fit in standard refrigerator doors so you can have chilled, purified water.

name: AirDoctor 3000 Carbon Filter
description: Replacement Dual-Action Carbon/Gas Trap/VOC filter for the AirDoctor 3000 air purifier.

faqs.question: When should I replace it?
faqs.answer: The filter indicator light on your AirDoctor 3000 will turn red when it is time to replace the carbon filter, typically every 6 months.

name: AquaTru VOC Filter
description: Stage 4 replacement filter for all AquaTru countertop models. Removes volatile organic compounds and improves taste.

name: AirDoctor 1000i
description: The smart version of the portable tower model, ideal for desktop use or small bedrooms. It fits into tight spaces while providing full AirDoctor purification performance. Includes Wi-Fi connectivity and app integration.

specs.smart_features: Wi-Fi enabled, app control, real-time AQI monitoring, filter change alerts

faqs.question: What is the difference between AD1000 and AD1000i?
faqs.answer: The AD1000i includes Wi-Fi connectivity, allowing you to control the purifier, monitor air quality, and receive filter change alerts directly from your smartphone via the AirDoctor app.

name: AirDoctor 2000i
description: The smart, compact and portable AirDoctor 2000i is designed for smaller spaces like nurseries, guest bedrooms, and home offices. It adds Wi-Fi app connectivity to the powerful UltraHEPA technology.

specs.smart_features: Wi-Fi enabled, app control, real-time indoor/outdoor air quality monitoring, remote scheduling

faqs.question: Can I schedule when it runs?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the AirDoctor app connected to your AD2000i, you can set custom schedules for the purifier to run.

name: AirDoctor 3000i
description: The smart version of the professional-grade AirDoctor 3000. It removes ultra-fine particles and features a powerful 3-stage filtration system with the added convenience of Wi-Fi control and app-based monitoring.

specs.smart_features: Wi-Fi enabled, app control, real-time AQI monitoring, filter change alerts, sharing control with family

faqs.question: Do I need the app to use the AD3000i?
faqs.answer: No, the AirDoctor 3000i can be operated manually using the control panel on the unit, just like the standard model. The app provides additional convenience and monitoring features.

name: AirDoctor 5000i
description: The smart version of our most powerful model, designed for large spaces, high ceilings, and open-concept living areas. The AD5000i features dual-sided filtration and full Wi-Fi connectivity.

specs.smart_features: Wi-Fi enabled, app control, advanced air quality tracking, filter status notifications

faqs.question: Can I control multiple units from the app?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can pair multiple 'i' series AirDoctor purifiers (like the 3000i and 5000i) to the same AirDoctor app for whole-home control.

name: AirDoctor 5500i
description: A high-performance smart air purifier closely related to the 5000i, offering exceptional coverage for extra-large spaces with dual filtration systems and full app integration.

specs.smart_features: Wi-Fi enabled, remote app control, air quality alerts, filter replacement tracking

faqs.question: What makes the 'i' version different?
faqs.answer: The 'i' indicates it is an IoT (Internet of Things) smart device, allowing it to connect to your home Wi-Fi network and communicate with the AirDoctor mobile app.

name: AirDoctor 3500
description: The AirDoctor 3500 is a highly capable air purifier for medium to large rooms, sharing similar performance specifications with the AD3000. It features a powerful 3-stage filtration system including an UltraHEPA filter.

faqs.question: How does it compare to the AD3000?
faqs.answer: The AD3500 shares similar performance specifications with the AD3000, including the same coverage area and CADR rating.

name: AirDoctor 4000
description: The AirDoctor AD4000 is a powerful air purification system designed to improve indoor air quality with its sleek, cylindrical design. It features an integrated UltraHEPA® + Premium Carbon/VOC Filter for high-efficiency particulate and odor removal.

specs.features: Cylindrical design, Mobility wheels, Air Quality Monitor, Auto Mode, Built-in Ionizer, Night Mode, Replace Filter Indicator, Control Lock

faqs.question: How often should I change the filter?
faqs.answer: The integrated filter should be replaced every 6 months depending on use and environmental conditions.

faqs.question: Does it have wheels?
faqs.answer: Yes, the AirDoctor 4000 features mobility wheels, making it easy to move from room to room.

faqs.question: How do I reset the Replace Filter light?
faqs.answer: The Replace Filter light is a solid red light. After changing to a genuine AirDoctor filter and installing it correctly, the light should turn off. If it flashes, check filter installation.

faqs.question: How much electricity does it use?
faqs.answer: It is very energy-efficient, consuming only 7 watts on low and 70 watts on the high setting. Running it 24/7 on Auto-mode costs about $30-40 per year.

name: AirDoctor 3000M
description: The AD3000M is a professional air purifier optimized for commercial or office environments. It focus on high-performance UltraHEPA™ filtration for maximum particulate removal in shared spaces.

specs.features: Filter Indicator Light, Filter Reset button, Control Lock

faqs.question: What is the filter lifespan?
faqs.answer: The UltraHEPA™ filter lasts up to 12 months, and the Pre-filter lasts up to 3 months, depending on the environment.

faqs.question: How do I reset the filter lights?
faqs.answer: To reset the filter indicators, press the illuminated 'Filter Reset' button on the control panel. The light will flash three times and turn off.

name: AirDoctor 5000H
description: The AirDoctor AD5000H is a high-performance professional air purifier designed for large spaces. It features a unique dual-sided filtration system with two sets of filters (one on each side) to provide maximum airflow. It is designed for settings requiring high-capacity particulate removal using UltraHEPA® technology.

specs.features: Dual-sided filtration, Filter Indicator Light, Control Lock, Whisper Mode

faqs.question: How many filters does the AD5000H use?
faqs.answer: The AD5000H uses two sets of filters—one on each side of the unit. Each set consists of an UltraHEPA® filter and a Pleated Pre-Filter, totaling four filters that should be replaced at the same time to maintain performance.

faqs.question: How do I reset the filter indicator light?
faqs.answer: After replacing the filters, press and hold the 'Filter Reset' button on the control panel for 3 seconds. The light will flash 3 times and then turn off.

faqs.question: What are the fan speed settings?
faqs.answer: The AD5000H has 6 fan speeds: Speed 1 is 'Whisper' mode for quiet operation, Speeds 2-3 are for everyday use, Speeds 4-5 are for high contaminants like smoke, and Speed 6 is 'Boost' for rapid purification.

faqs.question: Does it have a child lock?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can activate the Control Lock by pressing the 'Speed' and 'Timer' buttons simultaneously for 3 seconds.

faqs.question: Where should I place the AD5000H?
faqs.answer: Always keep the unit on the floor/ground. Maintain at least 1 foot of clearance from walls on both sides for proper airflow, and avoid placing it near fans or air conditioners.

faqs.question: How often should I replace the filters?
faqs.answer: The Pleated Pre-Filters last up to 6 months and the UltraHEPA® Filters last up to 12 months, depending on use and environmental conditions.
